scientific_integrity: Definitions and modalities use original published intuitionistic forcing clauses. Formula comparisons quantify over all persistent valuations; illustrative finite checks use an ordinary standalone checker, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-frame validity and finite recognition, not strong completeness or decidability of the unrestricted system; infinite claims rely on a symbolic proof; earlier ordered-frame equivalents cannot be excluded.
title: Dual order-closure correspondence for associative intuitionistic binary modalities
